# News article generation
**Type:** Behavioral indicator  
**Supporting papers:** 2  

## State of the Field

Producing full-length news articles based on provided public opinion statements, including headlines, quotations, and narrative framing, under conditions designed to test political bias and neutrality.

## Sources

**News article generation** (1 paper: [Fair or Framed? Political Bias in News Articles Generated by LLMs](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.856.pdf))
> Producing full-length news articles based on provided public opinion statements, including headlines, quotations, and narrative framing, under conditions designed to test political bias and neutrality.
